import json, pathlib, subprocess, re
root=pathlib.Path('.')
p='terraform/modules/better-stack-alert-evaluator/src/alert_definitions/'
def show(rev,path): return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',rev+':'+path]).decode()
def bundle(rev): return {d['id']:d for d in json.loads(show(rev,p+'dev.json'))['definitions']}
b,h=bundle('f10fa3435c'),bundle('d6f44c349')
ids={k for k in h if b.get(k)!=h[k]}
assert len(ids)==24
for f in pathlib.Path(p+'dev').glob('*.json'):
 doc=json.loads(f.read_text());changed=False
 for i,d in enumerate(doc['definitions']):
  if d['id'] in ids:
   assert d==b[d['id']], f'native delta: {d["id"]}'
   doc['definitions'][i]=h[d['id']];changed=True
 new=[d for k,d in h.items() if k not in b and d['metadata']['service']==f.stem]
 if new: doc['definitions']+=new;changed=True
 if changed:
  doc['definitions'].sort(key=lambda d:d['id'])
  f.write_text(json.dumps(doc,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
# Each unchanged-path patch is applied independently; stop on any conflict.
paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','f10fa3435c','d6f44c349','--','observability/']).decode().splitlines()
for path in paths:
 patch=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','f10fa3435c','d6f44c349','--',path])
 subprocess.run(['git','apply','-3'],input=patch,check=True)
# Existing assertions: apply only hunks still needed after the catalog split.
for path in ['scripts/test-better-stack-alert-evaluator.mjs','scripts/test-better-stack-dashboard-definitions.mjs','scripts/test-reconcile-better-stack-charts.mjs']:
 patch=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','f10fa3435c','d6f44c349','--',path]).decode()
 header=patch[:patch.index('@@')];hunks=re.split(r'(?=^@@ )',patch[patch.index('@@'):],flags=re.M)
 text=pathlib.Path(path).read_text()
 for hunk in hunks:
  if not hunk:continue
  if 'rewritten count alerts and their paused chart mirrors' in hunk:
   continue
  if any(s in hunk for s in ['expected_static_definition_count = 469','static alert definition package has expected parity coverage','static evaluator alert definitions have dashboard chart mirrors']):
   continue
  lines=hunk.splitlines(keepends=True)[1:]
  old=''.join(l[1:] for l in lines if l[:1] in (' ','-'))
  new=''.join(l[1:] for l in lines if l[:1] in (' ','+'))
  if old in text: text=text.replace(old,new,1)
  elif new in text: print('already present',path,hunk.splitlines()[0])
  else: raise Exception('hunk requires manual port: '+path+' '+hunk[:160])
 pathlib.Path(path).write_text(text)
# New JS cases reuse the existing loaded fixtures via exports, without duplicating setup.

pathlib.Path('scripts/test-crp-13579-windowed-count-alerts.mjs').write_text('import assert from "node:assert/strict";\nimport test from "node:test";\nimport { dashboards, nativeAlerts, staticDefinitions, managedCharts } from "./test-better-stack-dashboard-definitions.mjs";\n\n'+cases)

'''+specs+'\n'+helper+'class WindowedCountAlertsClickHouseTest(unittest.TestCase):\n'+fixture_methods+'\n\n'+methods+'if __name__ == "__main__":\n    unittest.main()\n'
